text.tspan: Privacy: direct messages to the bot from telegram-1b1b83f0:1000000101 now become turns of your Home,
as long as each identity's binding names you, this workspace's operator. Home's whole context — eve
rything you said in the canvas or tavi chat, its notes and notices — can shape the answers sent back
to those DMs, and their messages and replies are shown in Home. Only the identities listed are link
ed, and only in a chat channel's one-to-one conversation: group chats, forum topics, email and other
identities never are. /new in a linked DM ends nothing (Home never ends). Turn it off with `tavi co
nfig set chat.home-dm off`; a DM then returns to its own conversation from its next message.
